description: A male documentary narrator in his late forties, American with a neutral accent. A low, warm voice with a slight natural grain, recorded close to the microphone in a quiet studio. Measured, restrained and quietly intense, never theatrical or announcer-like: a serious long-form storyteller who has read every page of the case. Clear diction, an unhurried pace.
text: The bags are overweight. Only slightly. There's a small fee, and she pays it without a second thought. It's 2014, at an airport in China. Not long after, security staff call her aside. The officers want to know one thing. Are these bags hers? She says yes. Three years later, a court sentences her to death, with a two-year reprieve.
